pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because PHI's front held Hubbard at the 4.09 YPC they have allowed and a first-quarter deficit flipped CAR off the run, so he finished around 14 carries in the mid-50s with Dillon taking leftover snaps. Lemon lost because PHI actually led — CAR's 5.51 YPC run defense let Barkley, Pierce, and Hurts grind — Hurts threw under 25 times, and the throws that happened were Wicks' low-percentage shots (211 air yards turning into only 113 rec yards recently), leaving Lemon at 3 targets in the mid-teens. That counter is real on Hubbard's thin margin and is why he is a lean, not a strong; it is weaker on Lemon, whose 20.5 line still clears on about 5 targets at a modest yards per target.
slip_story: One story: CAR -3 controls a 39-total game on the ground (Hubbard rush over) while PHI chases underneath into a 36% blitz and a middle-of-field bleed (Lemon rec over). Do not add McMillan over 64.5, Wicks over 30.5, or a game total over — those need the shootout or the CAR-trails flip. Do not add Pierce over; his market role and his 14 rush yards in three games conflict, and the pack has no injury note to resolve it.
